name: The Fellowship Foundation

summary.text: The Fellowship Foundation (International Christian Leadership; also called the Family) is the organization built by Methodist minister Abraham Vereide whose dedicatory breakfast with President Eisenhower on February 5, 1953 at the Mayflower Hotel began the Presidential, now National, Prayer Breakfast.

sources.title: National Prayer Breakfast: What Does Its History Reveal?

facts.claim: The first Presidential Prayer Breakfast was International Christian Leadership's dedicatory breakfast at the Mayflower Hotel on February 5, 1953, attended by Eisenhower and some 400–500 people.
facts.quote: held at Hilton's Mayflower Hotel in Washington, D.C. with some 500 people attending
